name: AllScalars
description: Test type containing all standard scalar types

name: AppLogin
description: Database storage for spring security's remember-me feature

name: AppUser
description: Application users. Used to authenticate users by spring security. Can have additional fields/relations (See UserInfoService)

fieldDocs.name: created
fieldDocs.description: Creation date of the user entry

fieldDocs.name: disabled
fieldDocs.description: true if the user account was disabled

fieldDocs.name: roles
fieldDocs.description: Spring security roles of the user within the application

name: CNode
description: Abstract base class for all types in the FilterDSL condition hierarchy.

name: ConditionParser
description:
Specialized JSONParser setup to parse a FilterDSL node hierarchy into
the correct types.

name: FunctionNode
description: Implemented by operation and condition nodes which are all just defined by their name and their operands.

name: Injection
description: Encapsulates the data and meta data for a data injection.

fieldDocs.name: type
fieldDocs.description: The GraphQL type of the injection

name: ModuleFunctionReferences
description: Encapsulates the detected static function calls within one module.

fieldDocs.name: requires
fieldDocs.description: Map of variable names mapping to

name: QLiveBoostrap
description:
Encapsulates the data for a /api/bootstrap call or to be embedded in the HTML document.

 * QLive config - QLiveConfig wrapped in a JSONHolder
 * injected data - Prepared data for the starting view based on static analysis of TypeScript sources.

name: QLiveConfig
description: Contains the system configuration of a QLive system.

name: RsPackManifest
description: POJO implementation for rspack/rspack-manifest-plugin's manifest. Accepts any key, ensures the values are strings.

name: TrackUsageData
description: Encapsulates the information contained within a track-usage.json file on the java side. It contains the results of JavaScript code analysis that detects statically analyzable calls within the application react components and other modules.

name: ValueNode
description: Abstract base class for "Value nodes" within a FilterDSL condition hierarchy
